measures.what: outer diameter of the board, and total thickness including the LEDs (and thickness of the bare board alone)
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: the two small mounting holes near the centre: diameter of each, distance between their centres, and their position relative to the board centre (which axis they lie on, relative to the direction where the input wires leave)
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: the 4-pin input connector/wires: where they leave the board (distance from the centre, on the back face), the connector's width, and how far it sticks out behind the back face
measures.reply: led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: length and width of the board, board thickness, and the diameter of the four corner holes plus the centre-to-centre spacing of the holes along both directions
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.item: perfboard with ESP32 and everything soldered on
measures.what: height of the tallest thing above the board's top face, and height of anything sticking out below the bottom face (solder joints, pins)
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard grid: 18 x 24 holes at 2.54 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board

measures.what: position of the port mouth centre relative to the perfboard centre (along the board's long side, across, and height above the board's top face), the port mouth width and height, and which board edge it faces / how far the ESP32 overhangs or sits from that edge
measures.reply: esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 position: in female headers on the perfboard's columns 8 and 18, rows 2 to 23; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: the plug's overmold/body width, height and length that has to fit around the port opening (the largest cross-section of the USB-C connector housing where it enters a hole)
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.

measures.what: distance from the centre of one of the two small mounting holes to the nearest outer edge of the board (the board's radius is roughly that plus half the hole spacing), or the edge-to-edge width of the board with a ruler or tape
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: how tall the LEDs stand above the board face, how thick the bare circuit board is, and how far the wire connector and its solder joints/pads stick out of the back face (the side without LEDs)
measures.reply: led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: the USB-C port you will plug the charger into (the board has two at the same end: which one, COM or USB?) — its mouth centre distance from the perfboard's nearest short edge (positive if the mouth is inside the perfboard outline, negative if it overhangs), its centre distance from the perfboard's nearest long edge, the mouth's width and height, and the mouth's centre height above the perfboard's top face
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge; esp32 usb port height: the bottom of its USB-C receptacle is 12.54 mm above the perfboard's top, and the receptacle is about 3.2 mm tall and 10.67 mm wide, its centre 3.99 mm off the ESP32's centreline

measures.what: how far solder joints, header pins and screw terminals stick out below the bottom face; also the height and footprint (length x width and position) of the screw terminals and capacitor on the top face

measures.item: wall screws you will hang it on
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most

measures.what: Place it top face up with the ESP32's USB end pointing away from you. Report: (a) distance from the ESP32's left edge to the perfboard's left edge, and from the ESP32's right edge to the perfboard's right edge; (b) distance from the ESP32's USB end edge to the perfboard's end edge on that side, and whether the USB-C mouth sticks out past the ESP32's board edge (by how much); (c) is the USB-C port you use the left or the right one of the two; (d) distance between the centres of the two USB-C ports
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard grid: 18 x 24 holes at 2.54 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.item: screw terminals and capacitor on the perfboard
measures.what: with the same orientation (top face up, USB end away): for each, height above the top face, footprint length x width, and position (distance from the left edge and from the far USB end edge of the perfboard); and how far the solder joints / pins stick out of the underside

measures.item: USB-C cable plug you will use
measures.what: width, height and length of the plug's plastic overmold (the part behind the metal shell), and how long the metal shell is
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.
